first: आयुः कर्म च वित्तञ्च विद्या निधनमेव च ।
en: Length of life, work, wealth, learning and the time of death: these five are fixed for a being while it is still in the womb.
Sons, friends and relatives turn away from holy people; but those who follow such people bring merit to their whole family.
A fish, a tortoise and a bird care for their young by sight, by thought and by touch; in the same way, the company of good people nourishes us.
While this body is healthy and death is far away, do what is good for your soul; what can you do when life is ending?
Learning is like the wish-granting cow: it gives fruit even in hard times. Away from home it cares for you like a mother; learning is called hidden wealth.

first: एको ऽपि गुणवान् पुत्रो निर्गुणैश् च शतैर् वरः ।
en: One son with good qualities is better than a hundred without them; one moon drives away the dark, which thousands of stars cannot.
A fool who lives long is worse than a child who dies at birth; the dead child brings brief sorrow, but the fool burns you as long as he lives.
Living in a bad village, serving a man of low birth, bad food, a wife with an angry face, a foolish son and a widowed daughter burn the body without fire.

first: किं तया क्रियते धेन्वा या न दोग्ध्री न गर्भिणी ।
en: What use is a cow that gives no milk and bears no calf? What good is a son who is neither learned nor devoted?
For people burned by the troubles of the world, three things give rest: children, a wife, and the company of good people.
Kings speak only once, wise men speak only once, and a daughter is given in marriage only once: these three happen just once.

first: एकाकिना तपो द्वाभ्यां पठनं गायनं त्रिभिः ।
en: Do penance alone, study with two, sing with three, travel with four, farm with five, and fight with many.

first: सा भार्या या शुचिर्दक्षा सा भार्या या पतिव्रता ।
en: She is a true wife who is clean and capable, faithful to her husband, loving toward him, and truthful.
The house of a man with no son is empty, all directions are empty for one without relatives, a fool's heart is empty, and for the poor everything is empty.
Learning not practised is poison, food not digested is poison, social gatherings are poison to a poor man, and a young wife is poison to an old man.
Give up a religion that has no compassion, a teacher who has no learning, a wife with an angry face, and relatives who have no love.

first: अध्वा जरा मनुष्याणां वाजिनां बंधनं जरा ।
en: Constant travel ages a man, being tied up ages a horse, lack of love-making ages a woman, and sun ages clothes.

first: कः कालः कानि मित्राणि को देशः कौ व्ययागमौ ।
en: Think again and again: What is the time? Who are my friends? What is this place? What do I earn and spend? Who am I, and what is my strength?
For the twice-born, God is in the fire; for sages, God is in the heart; for those of little understanding, God is in images; for those who see all as equal, God is everywhere.
